_enabled: The operator enables the experiment. Unless this is the JSON value true, every mr-tester-ab command prints AB-SKIP disabled and mr-spawn renders the brief without the experiment's sentence.
_eligibility: A slice is in the experiment when it is listed in required_slices or starts with a prefix, and is not in exclude_slices. List design, refactor and doc-only slices of those prefixes in exclude_slices: they have no tester.
_runners: Each arm's test files are overlaid on a snapshot in <cache_root>/scratch and run by the first runner whose match fits. {files} expands to the files, {packages} to a -p pair per cargo package they belong to, {names} to their test names as a regex alternation, {junit} to the report path, {tool} to this directory. A file no runner fits (Playwright specs) is recorded not-run.
_mutants: The seeded-defect measure, reported beside confirmed findings and never a gate: on a slice whose merged diff changes a matching file, the changed lines are mutated once per arm with only that arm's tests that pass at merge deciding what is caught. One wall budget covers the slice.
_areas: The area of a slice is the one pattern its merged diff matches, mixed when it matches both, other when neither.
